literal: If one obtains relatives whose affection does not cease, it will give many prosperities that do not cease to bud.
translation: If one is blessed with relatives whose affection never wanes, it will yield many forms of ever-budding prosperity.
modern: அன்பு குறையாத சுற்றத்தாரைப் பெறின், அது என்றும் புதிய அரும்புகள் போலத் தோன்றி வளரும் பல செல்வங்களைத் தரும்.
explanation: This couplet highlights the immense value of having loyal and loving relatives. The word 'viruppara' refers to affection that never ceases or diminishes. The term 'aruppara' literally means 'without the buds ceasing', symbolizing continuous, fresh growth. The poet states that if a person secures a circle of relatives whose love is constant, that relationship itself becomes the source of endless, ever-renewing wealth and well-being.
